name: ParcelCourt
short: Review delivery claims against a jointly frozen handoff promise, attested evidence, challenges and independent semantic consensus.
problem: Delivery disputes depend on natural-language promises and evidence that may be incomplete or contradictory.
solution: Three distinct wallets set the promise, attest an evidence digest and submit evidence; GenLayer validators independently evaluate handoff, recipient authorization and sufficiency.
outcomes: SUPPORTED_DELIVERY, NOT_SUPPORTED, or UNRESOLVED. The recorded live case finalized UNRESOLVED.
productionQualification: INCOMPLETE: public app remains RELEASE_QUALIFIED=false pending signed-browser live E2E; do not submit as a fully qualified frontend.
